verdict.rationale: Dots lets a user personalize their single dot: name and appearance (dots-docs-3), action-handling rules (dots-docs-20), persistent notes on preferences and decisions (dots-docs-23), and connected knowledge sources such as Drive, Gmail, GitHub and local files (dots-docs-10, dots-docs-11). That is only a glancing match for building custom assistants, since it is one personal agent rather than purpose-built assistants. missing for 10: creating multiple distinct custom assistants, a dedicated instructions/system-prompt configuration, uploading a per-assistant knowledge base, sharing assistants with others or publishing them.
